settlement.luck_statement: 12 correct winners in 14 distinct games is a hit rate of 0.857 against 0.633 expected under the seals' own probabilities. The Poisson-binomial tail (p_at_least_observed_hits) is the only honest yardstick: below 0.05 the run is outside the noise band, but on 14 games in one week it is not a measured edge, it is not staked, and the bet surface still publishes zero rows.
settlement.p_at_least_observed_hits_note: Poisson-binomial tail: the chance of doing at least this well if the model's own probabilities are correct. Read this, not the hit rate. Above 0.05 the run is inside the noise band and is not evidence of skill.

finals_provenance.method: finals and quarter scores read from each game's official gamebook PDF 'SCORE BY PERIOD' table (statsdmz.nba.com) and cross-read against the final printed on nba.com/schedule for 2026-11-16, via the platform page-fetch tool. Bash egress cannot reach nba.com; the PDFs were read as text, not archived as binaries (F-V4-01).
finals_provenance.settle_rule: A game is SETTLED only when its official gamebook period row sums to the final for that club AND the final matches the official schedule/scoreboard. A club whose period row was not transcribed carries null quarters and is shown as unverified; nothing is back-solved from the final.

settle_rule: A game is settled only when a committed, official final covers it AND, where a period row was captured, that row sums to the final. Ungraded is not a loss and is never imputed. The stamp is the end of the latest graded game day.
luck_rule: Hit rate alone is not evidence. p_observed_run_under_model is the probability, under the seal's own probabilities, of the exact run of winners observed. If that number is not small, the run is luck.
